page.notes: The left edge of the scan cuts off the first letters of most lines, and the left margin notes are mostly cut off. Clipped letters are marked [?] or [illegible]. The left-margin section numbers 79, 180, 181 and 182 are visible and were kept. The page numbers 1001 (head) and 184 (foot, beside the catchword) are both printed; 184 is probably the printed page or column reference and is recorded here, not as a page number. The signature reads "Rrr 5". The catchword "Pau-" is at the foot right. Spelling is as printed, including "fideicommisso-rum" and "Tugurii" with the initial T partly hidden. Uncertain readings: "ducatur", "ERFAMILIAS" (the initial P is clipped), "Ælius" in the line "[?]lius ait", "[?]rnæ" and "[?]on ex eo" (the start and end of the Ædifi- line).
